subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The mother couldn’t _______ such an insult from her son in front of the others.
solution:
The correct answer is '**bear**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "bear" means to endure or tolerate something difficult or unpleasant. (सहन करना)
 
• It is the correct word used in the context of enduring an insult.
 
• The other options: "bier," "bare," and "beer" do not fit the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The mother couldn’t bear__ such an insult from her son in front of the others.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bier (मय्यत)**: A movable frame on which a coffin or corpse is placed before burial or cremation.
 
• **Bare (नंगा)**: Without covering or clothing; naked.
 
• **Beer (बीयर)**: An alcoholic drink made from yeast-fermented malt flavored with hops.
